scene: Digging into foam, you unearth three tokens showing city transit hubs.
picture: A bright pixel-art crossroads side-view. Far left, an open red double-decker bus waits beside a shelter. Centre, the boy with dark hair and red sneakers stands holding his skateboard and three shiny tokens. Up high swings an open rope-bridge lift basket. Far right, an idling paddle steamer bobs beside a sunlit pier.
shown: a double-decker bus waiting with open doors on the far left street
a swinging rope-bridge lift basket hovering open in the high centre
a striped paddle steamer idling at a wooden pier on the far right
